title: Name the Icon Buttons
prompt: Build a toolbar with three icon-only buttons — close, search, settings — each named with aria-labelledby pointing at visually hidden text (use the hidden attribute or a class), each <svg> icon marked aria-hidden="true". Add one normal text button labeled Save — which must NOT carry an aria-label (it names itself).

tests.name: three icon-only buttons labelled
tests.hint: Icon-only means the visible text is empty — the name must come from a hidden element via aria-labelledby.

tests.name: hidden labels carry real words
tests.hint: Hidden from sight, not from meaning: each referenced element must contain non-empty text.

tests.name: icons silent to assistive tech
tests.hint: The icon is decoration; the hidden text is the name. aria-hidden="true" keeps the icon out of the name.

tests.name: text button names itself
tests.hint: First rule of ARIA: a button with visible text already has a name — adding aria-label only risks a mismatch.
